# Clavis Encrypt 3.9.0

## ✨ A clearer name: Clavis Encrypt

- Clavis is now called **Clavis Encrypt** — in the title bar, the sidebar, About and the tray. Other apps share the name "Clavis" (including a password manager), and the new name makes it easy to tell which one is yours.
- Nothing else changes: same app, same install, same encryption. Your vaults, settings, licence and files are exactly as they were, and the Explorer menu and `clavis-cli` work as before.
- New and cheaper: **Pro is now $19 and Premium $29**, still one-time payments with every future update included.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
